Student Record Update System (Binary File + Random Access)

Problem Statement:
You are required to implement a Student Record Management System using:

Binary file handling

Object serialization

Random access for updating a specific record

🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Create a class Student

Data Members:

int roll

char name[20]

float marks

Member Functions:

void input()

void display()

2️⃣ Program Flow

Read number of students n

Write all student objects to binary file students.dat

Ask user for:

Record number to update (starting from 1)

New marks

Use random access (seekp) to update only that record

Re-read and display the updated record using seekg

🔹 Input Format
n
roll name marks
roll name marks
...
record_number
new_marks

🔹 Output Format

If valid record:

Record Updated Successfully
Updated Record:
Roll: <roll>
Name: <name>
Marks: <marks>

If invalid record:

Record not found
